image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a large adult common iguana resting on a rough, sandy rock surface near water. The iguana has dark greyish-brown coloration with prominent dorsal spines (crest) along its neck and back. Its head is turned slightly to the right, showing a large subtympanic shield, a dewlap, and textured scales. The front limbs are visible with distinct clawed digits gripping the rock. The background consists of blurred blue water with small waves.
